guitar.guitaristsText: Keith Richards / Ronnie Wood / Mick Taylor
guitar.modelsText: Fender Telecaster ('Micawber', 5-string open-G) / Gibson Les Paul / ES series
guitar.evidence: Keith Richards' 5-string open-G-tuned Telecaster 'Micawber' is one of the most famous specific guitars in rock history; this justifies high rather than medium confidence.
guitar.notes: Upgraded confidence from medium to high due to Richards' very specifically documented guitar/tuning setup.

tone.target: nasal fuzz riff with slight octave bite
tone.profile: nasal fuzz riff with slight octave bite
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing a Fuzz distortion unit followed by an AC30-style clean/mid-focused amp simulation, paired with a vintage cabinet to capture the raw, nasal sound of 'Satisfaction'.

rig.name: The Rolling Stones - (I Can't Get No) Satisfaction - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise inherent in fuzz tones.
Provide a slight mid-hump and tighten the attack before the main fuzz stage.
blocks.gap: The original tone is pure fuzz, but Green OD helps shape the initial bite without adding modern crunch.

blocks.purpose: Generate the core aggressive, nasal fuzz sound required for the main riff.
Simulate the classic British small combo amp sound, emphasizing mids and bite.
Provide the classic British cabinet voicing and raw character.
Slightly scoop the low end and boost mids to enhance the nasal bite and tightness.
blocks.gap: The tone is already aggressive, so EQ is used subtly for shaping rather than adding effects.

blocks.purpose: Explicitly bypass the wah pedal as requested by the musical verdict.
Ensure no delay wash is present.
Add minimal natural room ambience to ground the sound without washing it out.
blocks.gap: The tone should be raw, so reverb is kept very low.

improvements.summary: Replace the current cabinet IR with a more vintage, single-mic'd British cab simulation to enhance the raw, nasal character.

proposals.recommendedAsset: single-mic'd AC30 or Vox cab IR
proposals.reason: Enhance vintage bite and single-source focus for a rawer 60s sound.
